## Idea

The **right ideal generated by a [subset](ring-theory.subsets-rings.md)** `S` of
a [ring](ring-theory.rings.md) `R` is the least right ideal in `R` containing
`S`.

[`ring-theory.joins-right-ideals-rings`](ring-theory.joins-right-ideals-rings.md)
we will convert this fact to the fact that `S ↦ (S)` preserves joins.
